name: live-row-read-returns-mount-material
description: The success half of the invariant, on the simplest path: the render is still live and the caller owns it. The result's contents must declare a delivery channel — a component URL, a live channel carrying BOTH an endpoint and a token, or a server-emitted system card. Graded on the projected render meta, never on markup: what the shell looks like is a server's own presentation concern. Note the blueprintKey segment names nothing this server has ever stored, and the read succeeds anyway — that is deliberate, and it makes a second obligation graded here: when the row is present and readable, the ROW is what gets mounted and the supplied key is not consulted. A server that validated the key against its own records and refused the mismatch would fail this case, correctly, because a resume locator's key exists to resolve a render that is GONE.
